subject: Is it possible to output more than the top six elite configurations?

messages.subject: Is it possible to output more than the top six elite configurations?
parts: Hi, is it possible to output more than the top six elite configurations?  Say I wanted the top ten instead.

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to output more than the top six elite configurations?
parts:
Hi Daniel,

By default, the number of elite configurations is dynamic, they are the survivors of the race and they can be as few as one and as many as --min-survival. If you increase --min-survival to 10 you may get 10 or less. On the other hand, all configurations ever generated and their results are saved in the logFile, so you can always select a subset of those sorted by some criteria (by default, irace uses the sum of ranks). See the user guide https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/irace/vignettes/irace-package.pdf sections 9.2 and 9.3. I hope this answers your question.

Cheers,

Manuel.
